title: Incomplete U-Statistics of Equireplicate Designs: Berry-Esseen Bound and Efficient Construction
abstract: arXiv:2510.20755v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: U-statistics are a fundamental class of estimators that generalize the sample mean and underpin much of nonparametric statistics. Although extensively studied in both statistics and probability, key challenges remain: their high computational cost - addressed partly through incomplete U-statistics - and their non-standard asymptotic behavior in the degenerate case, which typically requires resampling methods for hypothesis testing. This paper presents a novel perspective on U-statistics, grounded in hypergraph theory and combinatorial designs. We identify the dependency graph of an incomplete U-statistic with the line graph of its design hypergraph and use Stein's method to derive Berry-Esseen bounds for deterministic designs under full degeneracy. translated_title: 等重复设计的不完全U统计量：Berry–Esseen界与高效构造
translated_abstract: U统计量是一类基本的估计量，它推广了样本均值的概念，并支撑着非参数统计的大部分内容。尽管在统计学和概率论中已被广泛研究，但其仍面临关键挑战：高昂的计算成本——不完全U统计量部分地解决了这一问题——以及其在退化情形下非标准的渐近行为，这通常需要借助重抽样方法来进行假设检验。本文基于超图理论和组合设计，为U统计量提供了一个全新的视角。我们将不完全U统计量的依赖图与设计超图的线图等同起来，并利用Stein方法在完全退化情形下为确定性设计推导出Berry–Esseen界。我们进一步将这些结果推广到学生化统计量，使用了一个专门针对完全退化情形设计的方差估计量。所得到的界为……建立了高斯极限（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文通过将不完全U统计量的依赖图视为其设计超图的线图，利用Stein方法首次在完全退化情形下为确定性设计建立了Berry–Esseen界，并推广至学生化统计量，从而在不依赖重抽样的前提下实现了高效构造与高斯极限推断。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the dependency graph of an incomplete U-statistic with the line graph of its design hypergraph and applies Stein's method to derive Berry-Esseen bounds under full degeneracy for deterministic designs, further extending them to studentized statistics and enabling efficient construction without resampling.
